paite: Huan Ephraimte akikaikhawm ua, mallam zuan in apai ua; Jephthah kiang ah, "Bangziak a Ammon suante dou dia hong paiphei a, na kiang a hoh dia hon chial sam lou? Na inn toh ka hon buhalkhawm ding uh,” achi uhi.
heading: Jephthah Leh Ephraim Mite
english: The men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said to Jephthah, “Why did you pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didn’t call us to go with you? We will burn your house around you with fire!”

paite: Jephthah in akiang uah, "Ammon suante ka mite toh theihtawp suah in ka dou ua; ka hon sap lai in akhut ua kipan in lah na hon hunkhe ut kei ua.
english: Jephthah said to them, “I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you didn’t save me out of their hand.

paite: Huchi in na hon hunkhe nuam kei uh chih ka theihtak in, sih khawk sa lou hial in ka pang a, Ammon suante dou ding in ka kuan a, huchi in TOUPA'N amaute ka khut ah ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in bangziak a hon dou dia tuni a hong kuan na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: When I saw that you didn’t save me, I put my life in my hand, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and Yahweh delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me today, to fight against me?”

paite: Huchi in Jephthah in Gilead mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Ephraimte adouta hi. Gileadte'n Ephraimte athat uhi. "Nou Gileadte, Ephraimte leh Manassehte lak a galtai vakvai maimaite na hi uh," achih ziak un.
english: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”

paite: Gileadte'n Ephraimte ma in Jordan lui kainate ana la ua; hichi ahong hi a, Ephraim mi suaktate'n, "Ka hong galkah ding uh," achih chiang un Gileadte'n akiang ah, "Ephraim mi na hi hia?” ana chi zel uh. Ama'n, "Hilou e,” achihleh,
english: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said, “Let me go over,” the men of Gilead said to him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he said, “No;”

paite: akiang ah, "Shiboleth, chi mah dih," ana chi ua, ama'n, "Siboleth," achi zaw zel a; alouchian thei kei hi. Huchi in aman ua, Jordan lui kainate ah ana that zel uh. Huchi in huai tung in Ephraimte singli-le-sangnih athat uhi.
english: then they said to him, “Now say ‘Shibboleth;’” and he said “Sibboleth”; for he couldn’t manage to pronounce it correctly, then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.

paite: Jephthah in Israelte tung ah kum guk vai ahawm a, huchi in asita a, Gilead gam a khua khat ah avui uhi.
english: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.

paite: Anung in Bethlehem a mi Ibzan in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: Ibzan, Elon Leh Abdon
english: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

paite: Ama'n tapa sawmthum leh tanu sawmthum anei hi. Atanute gamdang ah asawl a, atapate a ding in gamdang a pan tanu sawmthum apisak hi. Ama'n Israelte tung ah kum sagih vai ahawm hi.
english: He had thirty sons. He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan, and he brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.

paite: Ibzan asita a, Bethlehem ah avui uh.
english: Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

paite: Anung in Zebulun mi Elon in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm a; Israelte tung ah kum sawm vai ahawm hi.
english: After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

paite: Zebulun mi Elon asita a, Zebulun gam a Aijalon ah avui uhi.
english: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

paite: Huai nung in Pirathon mi, Hilel tapa Abdon in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.

paite: Ama'n tapa sawmli leh sabiltungnou sawmsagih tung a tuang zel tupa sawmthum anei hi. Ama'n Israelte tung ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
english: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.

paite: Pirathon mi, Hilel tapa Abdon asita a, Ephraim gam, Amalek mite tanggam ah Pirathon ah avuita uh.
english: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
